professionalSummary: Implementation consultant with three years of experience configuring payroll and absence products for mid‑sized employers under the configuration standard.
Conducted policy workshops, data reconciliation, training, and documentation for each implementation.
Collaborated with data migration and support teams to ensure smooth hand‑over.
experienceHighlights: Configured payroll and absence products for twenty‑three mid‑sized employers under the configuration standard.
Ran policy workshops using the workshop method, capturing policy decisions and resolving internal disagreements into recorded decisions with customer sign‑off.
Loaded and reconciled customer employee data with the data migration team, producing reconciliation reports signed by the customer HR lead.
Trained customers’ HR administrators following a training plan; go‑live approval remained with the implementation manager and was recorded on the go‑live checklist.
Authored limitation notes and hand‑over conditions for each implementation in the hand‑over pack to the support team.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s direct involvement in configuration, workshop facilitation, data reconciliation, training, and documentation for HR software implementations. They do not provide evidence of independent ownership, leadership, or production‑level deployment beyond the described activities.
